name: Horns of the Triceratops
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 4, ranger 3, shaman 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a piece fossilized horn)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The target grows three imposing horns as their hide thickens and grays. When you cast this spell the target grows three horns which can be used as a primary gore attack which deals 1d8 piercing damage plus 1-1/2 times their Strength modifier. If this gore attack is made at the end of a charge it deals double damage. In addition the target gains a bonus to natural armor equal to 1/3 your caster level.
